property_summary: For every successful Collect(_am) call, the amount of Ether actually transferred out of the contract to the caller, measured by the receiving counterparty's recorded msg.value, must equal _am; the mutant sends balances[msg.sender] instead of _am, so a recording helper observes a different value from _am whenever the caller's remaining balance differs from _am.
change_summary: Change the call value transferred to the caller from _am to the caller's full balance.
